prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. NOT a normal wide-angle photo, NOT collage. Keep source camera/orientation, apartment footprint, all real original exterior windows and black frames, adjacency and doorways. No new windows or rooms. Improve each surface junction, matte wood grain and joinery, cabinet reveals, real curtain fixings, textile weave, accessible storage, neutral daytime light, credible local work/reading lamps and contact shadows. Preserve 65inch TV on low1.80m console against COMPLETE SOLID wall opposite sofa. Interior white-framed frosted-glass doors must be OPAQUE. No people, text, logos, watermarks, plastic CGI, oversharpening, pointless props or plant overload. JAPANESE MID-CENTURY: warm gray-white plaster, deep walnut low furniture, smoked teak/oak tone floor, olive linen with small rust/caramel accent, paper/opal lamps and bronze. Thin proportions, tactile grain, restrained handcrafted ceramics; no orange varnish, no generic cream showroom.LIVING: original TV/sofa/window positions fixed. Resolve TV cable concealment, console recessed plinth and actual drawers, small accessible side table, task lamp at reading seat, restrained low table with one tray, well-cut sofa upholstery, two fabric scales, realistic low pile rug edge. Keep main circulation empty. Kitchen remains expanded .50m into dining, roughly7.6square metres. North run2.30m, hob/hood on solid north section left of original window, .68m prep then sink under original window, northeast fridge and .85m east auxiliary counter. Two perpendicular FULL-HEIGHT CLEAR GLASS TOP-HUNG telescopic banks: five WEST leaves stack at north window end (.74x.19m), four SOUTH leaves stack at east/right end(.62x.15m). Show BOTH banks FULLY RETRACTED, leaving open view and continuous wood floor, slim overhead tracks, NO floor rail, NO corner post, NO island. Leave thin top rails, no freestanding corner post, no floor rail and no spread glass across the opening.
